recs.stt: How do I deal with a difficult programmer joining an open source project?
recs.x:
Surprised that this isn't in the thread already.

Brian Fitzpatrick and Ben Collins-Sussman from Google have done a bunch of great talks about exactly this: How Open Source Projects Survive Poisonous People ( [link] )

recs.stt: GitHub Puts Open Code of Conduct on Pause
recs.x:
The SVN people did a great presentation about how to protect your project from poisonous people [1]. Their story goes is that someone came on the SVN mailing list ranting about how SVN sucks and doesn't have the features he wanted - according to the talk the SVN community was polite and the guy just went away.

[1] [link]
